out.title: Allotted INR 6 billion commercial papers at 8.75% yield
out.summary: Persistent Systems allotted 12,000 commercial papers of INR 500,000 face value each, aggregating INR 6 billion, on November 5, 2026; one-year tenure maturing November 5, 2027, at 8.75% discount/yield; ICICI Bank is issuing and paying agent.
